title: Microsoft Purview: DLP for network traffic through Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access
summary: The Purview control path stops at the advanced-rules option rather than reaching the audit or block control. It needs the documented Create rule and action-selection steps; the roadmap facts, activation requirement and reported licensing differences are supported.

claims.claim: The notice says no charges apply during public preview.
claims.quote: No charges will apply during public preview.

claims.claim: The notice describes the integration as altering how existing customer data is processed.
claims.quote:
Alters how existing customer data is processed

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Purview DLP integrates with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access to inspect sensitive files and text in transit to unmanaged cloud and AI apps across browsers and applications.
claims.quote: These controls apply to content shared from managed endpoints through browsers, applications, add-ins, APIs, and more.

claims.claim: The Scan with Purview content-rule action sends matching traffic to Purview for content inspection.
claims.quote: Global Secure Access forwards matching upload traffic to Microsoft Purview for content inspection.

claims.claim: Purview evaluates the content against the DLP policy and returns a rule-action decision.
claims.quote: Purview evaluates the content against your DLP policy and returns a decision based on your DLP rule action.

claims.claim: Global Secure Access enforces the Purview result, including blocking matching uploads or text.

claims.quote: OCR is not yet supported for traffic sent to Purview.

claims.quote: Certain file transfer methods may prevent inspection, such as if an application encodes a file within a JSON, or the file is broken up into multiple encrypted requests.

claims.quote: In scenarios where Purview inspection is unable to complete, such as a payload that is too large to inspect, or an internal error, the traffic is allowed (fail-open).

claims.claim: The PurviewStatus field in traffic logs identifies transactions that skipped inspection.
claims.quote: Transactions that have skipped inspection can be identified in Traffic logs using PurviewStatus field.

claims.quote: Scan with Purview only applies to traffic associated with an Entra user identity.

claims.quote: Traffic that cannot be mapped to an Entra user identity is not sent to Purview for inspection.

claims.quote: Purview network data security policies don't apply to B2B guest users.

claims.claim: The setup requires the Global Secure Access client on Windows or macOS.
claims.quote:
Install and configure the Global Secure Access client:
1. Install the Global Secure Access client on Windows or macOS.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The client device must be Microsoft Entra ID joined or hybrid joined.
claims.quote: The Global Secure Access client requires a device (or virtual machine) that is either Microsoft Entra ID joined or Microsoft Entra ID Hybrid joined.

claims.claim: QUIC over UDP is not supported.
claims.quote: User Datagram Protocol (UDP) traffic (that is, QUIC) isn't supported.

claims.claim: Sites that support fallback can use TCP when QUIC cannot be established.
claims.quote: Most websites support fallback to Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) when QUIC can't be established.

claims.claim: The DLP policy can run in simulation mode before activation.
claims.quote: On the Policy mode page, choose Turn the policy on immediately or run in simulation mode first to test.

claims.claim: The Learn example shows a blocked ChatGPT upload producing an error message.
claims.quote: Verify that the upload is blocked. ChatGPT displays an error message because Global Secure Access prevented the file transfer.

claims.claim: Blocking HTML or JSON text in basic content rules can block normal web and API traffic.
claims.quote: Web requests and responses commonly use HTML or JSON payloads, so blocking these text types can unintentionally block normal web and API traffic, including GET, POST, and PUT operations.

claims.claim: Requests are subject to API rate limiting based on usage.
claims.quote: Requests are subject to API rate limiting based on usage.

claims.claim: Exceeding rate limits blocks traffic fail-closed.
claims.quote: When limits are exceeded, traffic is automatically blocked (fail-closed).

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Purview DLP rule actions should match the content types and activities configured in the Global Secure Access content policy.
claims.quote: The actions you select in the Purview DLP rule should match the content types and activities you selected in the Global Secure Access content policy.

claims.claim: After integration configuration, policy distribution to the network solution can take up to 24 hours.
claims.quote: After you configure the integration between Microsoft Purview and your network security solution, allow up to 24 hours for your policies to be distributed to the network security solution and for the first data to show up.

claims.claim: Once the services fully communicate, request data can take up to 30 minutes to appear in the audit log and activity explorer.
claims.quote: Once the two services fully communicate with each other, it can take up to 30 minutes for data about a request from a client to a website or cloud app to appear in the audit log and activity explorer.

claims.claim: Conditional Access applies the Global Secure Access security profile to selected users and groups.
claims.quote:
Select the users and groups to apply the policy to.
Set the Target resources to All internet resources with Global Secure Access.

claims.claim: Configuration requires a content policy linked to a security profile and a Conditional Access policy enforcing that profile.
claims.quote:
To configure a content policy in Global Secure Access, complete the following steps:
1. Create a content policy.
2. Link the content policy to a security profile.
3. Configure a Conditional Access policy.

claims.claim: The Entra path to Scan with Purview is Global Secure Access > Secure > Content policies > + Create Policy > Basics > Rules > rule > Action > Scan with Purview.
claims.quote: Browse to Global Secure Access > Secure > Content policies. ... Select + Create Policy. ... On the Basics tab: ... On the Rules tab: ... Add a new rule. ... Action menu: ... select Scan with Purview.

claims.claim: A Microsoft Graph operation setting a content policy rule to Scan with Purview is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Global Secure Access content policy rules Microsoft Graph Scan with Purview contentFilteringRule API; graph contentPolicy Purview; networkaccess Scan with Purview. Opened content filtering, Graph Internet Access tutorial, filteringRule and network access API overview; no such operation.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; controls[1].note; Governance controls: second row
claims.claim: The printed Purview route reaches the audit or block control, with its remaining action steps supplied by the row note.
claims.quote:
Select Create or customize advanced DLP rules and select Next.
Select + Create rule and configure the rule: ... Under Actions, select + Add an action > Restrict browser and network activities.
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].ui.path with 'Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Inline web traffic > Custom > Custom policy > Choose where to enforce the policy > Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers > Create or customize advanced DLP rules > + Create rule > Actions > + Add an action > Restrict browser and network activities'. Keep the note explaining that the relevant activities are set to Audit or Block there. The cited page documents the missing + Create rule step between the printed path and the note's action steps.

claims.claim: No documented automation is provided for setting the inline network DLP rule's audit or block action.
claims.quote: Searched: New-DlpComplianceRule RestrictBrowserNetworkActivities Block network Inline web traffic; Set-DlpComplianceRule network browser. Read New-DlpComplianceRule reference and Set syntax; RestrictAccess example is for Application, not Network; no documented network action mapping.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy accepts Network for EnforcementPlanes, which selects the policy enforcement layer rather than its audit or block rule action.
claims.quote: The EnforcementPlanes parameter defines the layer where policy actions are run. ... Valid values are: ... Network

claims.claim: The Entra route to the security-profile session control is Identity > Protection > Conditional Access > + Create new policy > Session > Use Global Secure Access Security Profile.
claims.quote: Browse to Identity > Protection > Conditional Access. ... Select + Create new policy. ... Under Session, select Use Global Secure Access Security Profile and select the security profile you created.

claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.
